<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden Bird Dance</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#f8faff}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf8faff);
scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xf8faff,12,27);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({preserveDrawingBuffer:true});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240,294);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = .96;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const viewHeight = 4.704;
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(
  -viewHeight*240/294/2,viewHeight*240/294/2,
  viewHeight/2,-viewHeight/2,.1,100
);
ref.name = 'reference-camera';
ref.position.set(.30,3.40,10);
ref.lookAt(.30,2.40,0);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffff2,0xaaa5a0,1.45));

const keyLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff6dd,2.7);
keyLight.position.set(-3.5,7,5);
keyLight.castShadow = true;
keyLight.shadow.mapSize.set(1024,1024);
Object.assign(keyLight.shadow.camera,{
  left:-3,right:3,top:6,bottom:-1,near:.5,far:20
});
keyLight.shadow.normalBias = .025;
keyLight.shadow.bias = -.0002;
keyLight.shadow.radius = 4;
keyLight.target.position.set(0,2,0);
scene.add(keyLight,keyLight.target);

const backLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xf3f5ff,1.15);
backLight.position.set(3,5,-5);
scene.add(backLight);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,.45);
fill.position.set(4,3,5);
scene.add(fill);

const floor = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200,200),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xd5d4c9,roughness:1})
);
floor.name = 'matte-ground';
floor.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
floor.position.y = -.23;
floor.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(floor);

let seed = 19387;
function rand(){
  seed = (Math.imul(seed,1664525)+1013904223)>>>0;
  return seed/4294967296;
}
const grainData = new Uint8Array(64*64*4);
for(let i=0;i<64*64;i++){
  const v=110+Math.floor(rand()*115);
  grainData[i*4]=v;
  grainData[i*4+1]=v;
  grainData[i*4+2]=v;
  grainData[i*4+3]=255;
}
const grain = new THREE.DataTexture(grainData,64,64,THREE.RGBAFormat);
grain.wrapS = grain.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping;
grain.repeat.set(4,4);
grain.magFilter = grain.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
grain.needsUpdate = true;

function material(color,extra={}){
  return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
    color,roughness:.98,metalness:0,
    bumpMap:grain,bumpScale:.004,dithering:true,...extra
  });
}
const plumage = material(0xffffff,{vertexColors:true});
const headMat = material(0xf2c222);
const lidMat = material(0xecc027);
const beakMat = material(0xdcc12a);
const lowerBeakMat = material(0xc4a62b);
const mouthMat = material(0x76672a,{bumpMap:null});
const socketMat = material(0xa3a545,{bumpMap:null});
const pupilMat = material(0x42442b,{bumpMap:null,roughness:.65});
const eyeGlintMat = material(0xf3ffd7,{bumpMap:null,roughness:.4});
const handMat = material(0x626047,{bumpScale:.003});
const fingerMat = material(0x4e503b,{bumpScale:.002});
const footMat = material(0xe3a619);

function group(name,parent,x=0,y=0,z=0){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name=name;
  g.position.set(x,y,z);
  if(parent) parent.add(g);
  return g;
}
const sphereGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24);
function ellipsoid(name,parent,mat,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz){
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(sphereGeometry,mat);
  m.name=name;
  m.position.set(x,y,z);
  m.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);
  m.castShadow=true;
  m.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

function sample(rows,y,k){
  let i=0;
  while(i<rows.length-2 && y>rows[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=rows[i],b=rows[i+1];
  const p=rows[Math.max(0,i-1)],n=rows[Math.min(rows.length-1,i+2)];
  const d=b[0]-a[0],t=THREE.MathUtils.clamp((y-a[0])/d,0,1);
  const m0=(b[k]-p[k])/(b[0]-p[0]);
  const m1=(n[k]-a[k])/(n[0]-a[0]);
  return (2*t*t*t-3*t*t+1)*a[k]
    +(t*t*t-2*t*t+t)*d*m0
    +(-2*t*t*t+3*t*t)*b[k]
    +(t*t*t-t*t)*d*m1;
}
function profileMesh(name,parent,rows,mat,colorFn){
  const heightSteps=88,sides=64;
  const pos=[],uv=[],colors=[],indices=[];
  const y0=rows[0][0],y1=rows[rows.length-1][0];
  for(let i=0;i<=heightSteps;i++){
    const y=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(y0,y1,i/heightSteps);
    const cx=sample(rows,y,1),rx=Math.max(0,sample(rows,y,2));
    const rz=Math.max(0,sample(rows,y,3)),cz=sample(rows,y,4);
    for(let j=0;j<=sides;j++){
      const a=j/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const x=cx+rx*Math.cos(a),z=cz+rz*Math.sin(a);
      pos.push(x,y,z);
      uv.push(j/sides,i/heightSteps);
      if(colorFn){
        const c=colorFn(x,y,z,a);
        colors.push(c.r,c.g,c.b);
      }
      if(i<heightSteps && j<sides){
        const a0=i*(sides+1)+j,b=a0+sides+1;
        indices.push(a0,b,b+1,a0,b+1,a0+1);
      }
    }
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));
  if(colorFn) geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.castShadow=true;
  mesh.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function taperedCurve(name,parent,points,r0,r1,mat){
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points.map(p=>new THREE.Vector3(...p)));
  const count=20,sides=9;
  const frames=curve.computeFrenetFrames(count,false);
  const positions=[],uvs=[],indices=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=count;i++){
    const t=i/count,p=curve.getPointAt(t);
    const r=THREE.MathUtils.lerp(r0,r1,t);
    for(let j=0;j<=sides;j++){
      const a=j/sides*Math.PI*2;
      const v=p.clone()
        .addScaledVector(frames.normals[i],Math.cos(a)*r)
        .addScaledVector(frames.binormals[i],Math.sin(a)*r);
      positions.push(v.x,v.y,v.z);
      uvs.push(j/sides,t);
      if(i<count && j<sides){
        const k=i*(sides+1)+j,l=k+sides+1;
        indices.push(k,k+1,l+1,k,l+1,l);
      }
    }
  }
  const start=positions.length/3;
  const p0=curve.getPointAt(0),p1=curve.getPointAt(1);
  positions.push(p0.x,p0.y,p0.z,p1.x,p1.y,p1.z);
  uvs.push(.5,0,.5,1);
  for(let j=0;j<sides;j++){
    indices.push(start,j+1,j);
    const k=count*(sides+1)+j;
    indices.push(start+1,k,k+1);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uvs,2));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,mat);
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.castShadow=true;
  mesh.receiveShadow=true;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const bird=group('golden-bird',scene);
const torso=group('torso-sway-and-breath',bird,0,2,0);
const body=group('body-and-neck',torso,0,-2,0);

const gold=new THREE.Color(0xf2bb1e);
const orange=new THREE.Color(0xeda91b);
const cream=new THREE.Color(0xffdd83);

profileMesh('continuous-pear-shaped-body',body,[
  [1.035,-.025,0,0,.01],
  [1.14,-.025,.46,.40,.015],
  [1.34,-.025,.67,.60,.035],
  [1.60,-.025,.83,.77,.065],
  [1.94,-.025,.93,.92,.075],
  [2.23,-.035,.895,.98,.065],
  [2.53,-.04,.80,.91,.035],
  [2.82,-.025,.69,.76,.005],
  [3.08,0,.63,.62,-.005],
  [3.34,.025,.54,.46,-.018],
  [3.56,.035,.43,.36,-.015],
  [3.78,.04,.335,.29,-.01],
  [3.99,.04,.285,.25,-.005],
  [4.12,.04,0,0,0]
],plumage,(x,y,z,a)=>{
  const front=Math.pow(Math.max(0,Math.sin(a)),1.1);
  const belly=Math.exp(-Math.pow((x+.07)/.69,2)-Math.pow((y-2.46)/.93,2))*front;
  const base=orange.clone().lerp(gold,THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,1.3,3.4));
  return base.lerp(cream,belly*.91);
});

function makeLeg(side){
  const left=side<0;
  const hipX=left?-.36:.31;
  const ankleX=left?-.22:.32;
  const leg=group(left?'left-leg':'right-leg',bird,hipX,1.3,0);
  const rows=[
    [-.36,ankleX,0,0,.02],
    [-.20,ankleX,.185,.205,.02],
    [.10,ankleX,.205,.235,.02],
    [.46,left?-.27:.31,.235,.27,.015],
    [.86,left?-.33:.31,.275,.305,0],
    [1.18,hipX,left?.315:.285,.345,-.025],
    [1.46,hipX,.30,.32,-.035],
    [1.65,hipX,0,0,-.04]
  ].map(r=>[r[0]-1.3,r[1]-hipX,r[2],r[3],r[4]]);
  const c0=new THREE.Color(left?0xeaa51a:0xe8ac1e);
  const c1=new THREE.Color(0xf4bb29);
  profileMesh('tapered-leg',leg,rows,plumage,(x,y,z,a)=>
    c0.clone().lerp(c1,.28*Math.max(0,Math.sin(a)))
  );
  const foot=group(left?'left-foot':'right-foot',leg,ankleX-hipX,-1.60,.095);
  ellipsoid('rounded-foot',foot,footMat,0,-.035,.085,.235,.105,.32);
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    const toe=group('toe-'+(i+1),foot);
    ellipsoid('toe',toe,footMat,(i-1)*.115,-.045,.30,.065,.065,.19);
  }
  return leg;
}
const leftLeg=makeLeg(-1);
const rightLeg=makeLeg(1);

function makeHand(parent,side){
  const hand=group(side<0?'left-hand':'right-hand',parent);
  const palm=group('palm',hand);
  const p=ellipsoid('olive-palm',palm,handMat,side*.025,-.105,.025,.105,.14,.068);
  p.rotation.z=side*.10;
  const fingers=[];
  const lengths=[.20,.265,.28,.22];
  for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
    const x=(i-1.5)*.052+side*.025;
    const dx=(i-1.5)*.025+side*.014;
    const len=lengths[i];
    const f=group('finger-'+(i+1),hand,x,-.16,.035);
    taperedCurve('proximal-finger',f,[
      [0,0,0],[dx*.18,-len*.24,.014],[dx*.4,-len*.57,.024]
    ],.029,.023,fingerMat);
    const tipJoint=group('finger-tip-joint',f,dx*.4,-len*.57,.024);
    taperedCurve('distal-finger',tipJoint,[
      [0,0,0],[dx*.32,-len*.21,.006],[dx*.6,-len*.43,-.009]
    ],.023,.012,fingerMat);
    ellipsoid('rounded-fingertip',tipJoint,fingerMat,
      dx*.6,-len*.43,-.009,.013,.017,.014);
    fingers.push({root:f,tip:tipJoint});
  }
  const thumb=group('thumb',hand);
  taperedCurve('bent-thumb',thumb,[
    [-side*.062,-.055,.045],
    [-side*.12,-.10,.073],
    [-side*.145,-.18,.081],
    [-side*.13,-.25,.07]
  ],.036,.017,handMat);
  ellipsoid('thumb-tip',thumb,handMat,-side*.13,-.25,.07,.017,.022,.018);
  hand.userData={fingers,thumb,side};
  return hand;
}

const wingGold=new THREE.Color(0xeeb919);
const wingLight=new THREE.Color(0xf7c523);
const wristColor=new THREE.Color(0x9f9135);
function wingColor(x,y,z,a){
  return wingGold.clone().lerp(wingLight,Math.max(0,Math.sin(a))*.25);
}
function makeArm(side){
  const left=side<0;
  const shoulder=new THREE.Vector3(left?-.65:.62,left?3.25:3.27,left?-.045:.10);
  const arm=group(left?'left-arm':'right-arm',torso,
    shoulder.x,shoulder.y-2,shoulder.z);
  const upper=group('upper-wing',arm);
  profileMesh('rounded-upper-wing',upper,[
    [-1.10,0,0,0,0],
    [-1,0,.105,.105,0],
    [-.80,0,.122,.125,0],
    [-.35,0,.148,.156,0],
    [0,0,.150,.155,0],
    [.15,0,0,0,0]
  ],plumage,wingColor);
  const elbow=group('elbow',arm);
  ellipsoid('rounded-elbow',elbow,headMat,0,0,0,.108,.11,.108);
  const fore=group('fore-wing',elbow);
  profileMesh('tapering-fore-wing',fore,[
    [-1.10,0,0,0,0],
    [-1,0,.054,.061,0],
    [-.85,0,.064,.074,0],
    [-.45,0,.083,.095,0],
    [0,0,.105,.105,0],
    [.12,0,0,0,0]
  ],plumage,(x,y,z,a)=>{
    const c=wingColor(x,y,z,a);
    return c.lerp(wristColor,1-THREE.MathUtils.smoothstep(y,-1,-.76));
  });
  const hand=makeHand(arm,side);
  return {arm,upper,elbow,fore,hand,shoulder};
}
const leftArm=makeArm(-1);
const rightArm=makeArm(1);

const head=group('head',torso,.04,2.08,-.015);
ellipsoid('rounded-feathered-skull',head,headMat,0,0,0,.35,.405,.36);

const crown=group('crown-feathers',head);
for(let i=0;i<13;i++){
  const x=(rand()-.5)*.35,z=(rand()-.5)*.22;
  const y=.405*Math.sqrt(Math.max(0,1-x*x/(.35*.35)-z*z/(.36*.36)));
  const f=ellipsoid('small-crown-feather-'+i,crown,headMat,
    x,y-.012,z,.022,.035,.023);
  f.rotation.z=(rand()-.5)*.35;
}

const eyes=group('eyes',head);
const eyeParts=[];
function makeEye(side){
  const eye=group(side<0?'left-eye':'right-eye',eyes,side*.165,.105,.267);
  eye.rotation.y=side*.22;
  const socket=ellipsoid('muted-golden-eye',eye,socketMat,0,0,0,.064,.082,.026);
  const pupil=ellipsoid('dark-pupil',eye,pupilMat,side*.004,-.001,.024,.045,.059,.016);
  const glint=ellipsoid('eye-catchlight',eye,eyeGlintMat,-.012,.021,.039,.008,.010,.004);
  const upper=group('upper-eyelid',eye);
  const lid=ellipsoid('heavy-yellow-lid',upper,lidMat,0,.028,.014,.077,.026,.032);
  lid.rotation.z=side*.07;
  const lower=ellipsoid('lower-eyelid',eye,headMat,0,-.032,.009,.069,.013,.026);
  const brow=ellipsoid('soft-brow',eye,headMat,-side*.003,.064,-.016,.085,.033,.035);
  brow.rotation.z=-side*.10;
  eyeParts.push({eye,socket,pupil,glint,lid,lower,brow,side});
}
makeEye(-1);
makeEye(1);

const mouth=group('beak-and-mouth',head,.012,-.078,.286);
const lowerBill=ellipsoid('lower-bill',mouth,lowerBeakMat,0,-.018,.094,.169,.037,.133);
const upperBill=ellipsoid('short-upper-bill',mouth,beakMat,0,.025,.092,.194,.063,.162);
const mouthLine=taperedCurve('expressive-mouth-line',mouth,[
  [-.164,-.013,.151],
  [-.105,-.022,.219],
  [.005,-.026,.246],
  [.105,-.021,.222],
  [.169,-.010,.154]
],.007,.005,mouthMat);
const mouthBase=mouthLine.geometry.attributes.position.array.slice();
const nostrils=group('nostrils',mouth);
ellipsoid('left-nostril',nostrils,lowerBeakMat,-.080,.054,.205,.012,.006,.006);
ellipsoid('right-nostril',nostrils,lowerBeakMat,.080,.054,.205,.012,.006,.006);

  x:0,y:0,s:1,wx:1,stretch:1,pitch:0,roll:0,yaw:0,hs:1,

function add(t,p){
  keys.push({...((keys.length)?keys[keys.length-1]:base),...p,t});
}

  x:-.015,y:-.26,s:1.065,wx:1.015,stretch:1,pitch:0,roll:.08,yaw:-.03,hs:1.08,

function quaternionFrom(a){
  return new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(new THREE.Euler(a[0],a[1],a[2],'ZYX'));
}
for(const k of keys){
  k.qL=quaternionFrom(k.Lrot);
  k.qR=quaternionFrom(k.Rrot);
  k.qH=quaternionFrom(k.Hrot);
}

const down=new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0);
function poseArm(arm,elbow,wrist){
  const e=new THREE.Vector3(...elbow);
  const w=new THREE.Vector3(...wrist);
  const upperDirection=e.clone().sub(arm.shoulder);
  const foreDirection=w.clone().sub(e);
  const upperLength=upperDirection.length();
  const foreLength=foreDirection.length();

  arm.upper.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(down,upperDirection.clone().normalize());
  arm.upper.scale.set(1,upperLength,1);
  arm.elbow.position.copy(upperDirection);
  arm.fore.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(down,foreDirection.normalize());
  arm.fore.scale.set(1,foreLength,1);
  arm.hand.position.copy(w.sub(arm.shoulder));
}
function poseFingers(hand,curl,spread,size){
  hand.scale.setScalar(size);
  const d=hand.userData;
  for(let i=0;i<d.fingers.length;i++){
    const f=d.fingers[i];
    f.root.rotation.set(curl*.25,0,(i-1.5)/1.5*spread);
    f.tip.rotation.x=curl*1.75;
  }
  d.thumb.rotation.set(curl*.22,0,-d.side*spread*.24);
}

const sleepyPupilColor=new THREE.Color(0x42442b);
const awakePupilColor=new THREE.Color(0x14251b);

function render(t){
  const time=((Number.isFinite(t)?t:0)%5540+5540)%5540;
  let index=0;
  while(index<keys.length-2 && time>=keys[index+1].t) index++;
  const a=keys[index],b=keys[index+1];
  const u=(time-a.t)/(b.t-a.t);
  const f=u*u*(3-2*u);
  const n=name=>THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[name],b[name],f);
  const v=name=>[
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[name][0],b[name][0],f),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[name][1],b[name][1],f),
    THREE.MathUtils.lerp(a[name][2],b[name][2],f)
  ];

  bird.position.set(n('x'),n('y'),0);
  bird.rotation.set(0,n('yaw'),0);
  bird.scale.setScalar(n('s'));

  torso.position.set(0,2,0);
  torso.rotation.set(n('pitch'),0,n('roll'),'XYZ');
  torso.scale.set(n('wx'),n('stretch'),1);

  head.quaternion.slerpQuaternions(a.qH,b.qH,f);
  head.scale.setScalar(n('hs'));

  poseArm(leftArm,v('Le'),v('Lw'));
  poseArm(rightArm,v('Re'),v('Rw'));
  leftArm.hand.quaternion.slerpQuaternions(a.qL,b.qL,f);
  rightArm.hand.quaternion.slerpQuaternions(a.qR,b.qR,f);
  poseFingers(leftArm.hand,n('Lcurl'),n('Lspread'),n('Lsize'));
  poseFingers(rightArm.hand,n('Rcurl'),n('Rspread'),n('Rsize'));

  const ll=v('Lleg'),rl=v('Rleg');
  leftLeg.rotation.set(ll[0],ll[1],ll[2]);
  rightLeg.rotation.set(rl[0],rl[1],rl[2]);

  const openness=n('open');
  pupilMat.color.copy(sleepyPupilColor).lerp(awakePupilColor,openness);
  for(const e of eyeParts){
    e.eye.position.set(e.side*(.165+.075*openness),.105,.267+.03*openness);
    e.socket.scale.y=.082*(.5+.5*openness);
    e.pupil.scale.x=.045*(.54+.46*openness);
    e.pupil.scale.y=.059*(.39+.61*openness);
    e.glint.scale.set(.008*openness,.010*openness,.004*openness);
    e.lid.position.y=.028+.052*openness;
    e.lid.scale.y=.026*(1-.35*openness);
    e.lower.position.y=-.032-.038*openness;
    e.brow.position.y=.064+.036*openness;
  }

  const smile=n('smile');
  lowerBill.position.y=-.018-n('jaw')*.035;
  upperBill.scale.y=.063*(1-.10*Math.max(0,smile));
  const attr=mouthLine.geometry.attributes.position;
  for(let i=0;i<attr.count;i++){
    const j=i*3;
    const x=mouthBase[j];
    attr.array[j]=x;
    attr.array[j+1]=mouthBase[j+1]+smile*.045*
      (Math.pow(Math.min(1,Math.abs(x)/.17),1.5)-.35);
    attr.array[j+2]=mouthBase[j+2];
  }
  attr.needsUpdate=true;
  mouthLine.geometry.computeVertexNormals();

  scene.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}

window.nwb={
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras:{ref},
  characters:[bird],
  render,
  ready:true
};
render(0);
